hypotheses: Repeat visits survive a rival's price cut or promotion. Proposed test threshold: at least 30% of stamp-card holders return within 14 days.
Tasting changes price tolerance. Proposed test threshold: at least 40% of tasters choose S$4.80 or higher on the price-ladder card.
Customers accept S$4.80 for Corner Brew. Proposed test threshold: purchases at S$4.80 reach at least 70% of purchases at S$3.84 on the price board.
Chain café regulars will try a new café with a first-visit offer. Proposed test threshold: at least 5% of 200 flyers are redeemed within 7 days.
Pre-ordering removes the queue barrier for lunch. Proposed test threshold: at least 15% of Telegram subscribers pre-order within a week.
